meta.source: v2: measured from 34 lossless 3x onboarding/home screens (Figma export 'Cal Ai - APP UI Design', 1179x2556 px = 393x852 pt, 3 px/pt). Tokens marked 'lossy' come from the v1 marketing screenshots and were not visible in the Figma set.

color.note: Monochrome: pure black text and selections, near-black ink buttons, white canvas, and a lavender-white (surface-2) for every quiet surface. Colour is reserved for data (macros, streak) and warm highlights (accent). v2 values are exact from 3x lossless screens unless the note says lossy.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: All primary text in the app (titles, subtitles, option labels, numbers) and the SELECTED option card fill; also Get Started, paywall CTA and Sign in with Apple. 21:1 on surface, 19.9:1 on surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Continue, Yes/No), FAB, tooltip, calorie ring progress. Measured #1c1a22–#1e1a24 on every CTA. White on it 17.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: review body, labels under stats ('Calories left' context), axis labels. 4.58:1 on surface, 4.33:1 on surface-2 (just under 4.5 — keep it ≥15px there).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders ('Referral Code') and helper lines ('You can edit this anytime'). 2.83:1 on surface, 2.68:1 on surface-2 — FAILS 4.5:1; kept from source. Never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Inactive side of a binary label pair ('Metric' when Imperial is on) and the farthest wheel-picker values. 1.56:1 — decorative; the active side is black.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink / black fills. 17.2:1 on ink, 21:1 on black.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink (tooltip date). 6.5:1 on ink. Lossy estimate.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background: onboarding is pure white; home is white under a top glow.

tokens.name: canvas-glow
tokens.usage: Warm top-right stop of the home screen's top gradient (measured #f0eae7–#f3eae8), fading to canvas by ~200pt.

tokens.name: canvas-glow-2
tokens.usage: Cool top-left stop of the home top gradient (measured #e1e5e6–#e3e8e9).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tab bar, chips on photos, inner plan cards.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: The app's signature lavender-white: unselected option cards, list rows, back button, language pill, inputs, review card, 'Daily recommendation' container, notification card.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Wheel-picker selection pill, quiet rows.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Segmented control track. Lossy.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Active tab pill, pressed quiet surfaces.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Step progress-bar track, switch off state (#e9e9e9), rollover chip, ruler fill (#e3e3e3).

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: Track behind every progress ring (calories, macros, plan cards). Cool, very light.

tokens.name: slider-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of the speed slider (4pt).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card hairlines and dividers (1px). Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stepper and light outline-button borders (1px). Lossy. Decorative.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button fill (Continue before a choice). White label on it 1.94:1 — disabled, exempt.

tokens.name: disabled-2
tokens.usage: Disabled inline button inside an input (Submit).

tokens.name: protein
tokens.usage: Protein ring, icon and label; also 'Yesterday' text and the red end of the setup gradient. Measured #da6365–#e4666c. 3.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: carbs
tokens.usage: Carbs ring, icon and label. 2.35:1 on surface — FAILS for text; kept from source. Pair with the word 'Carbs'.

tokens.name: fat
tokens.usage: Fat ring, icon and label; also highlighted numbers like '200 cals'. Measured #6493db–#6698df. 3.02:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm highlight: rating stars, laurels, the '6 kg' in statements, goal markers. Alias of carbs (measured identical #e09a63).

tokens.name: tint-over
tokens.usage: Header tint on the 'Yesterday' rollover card, behind protein-coloured text (3.03:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Weight chart line to the selected point, positive trend arrow. 3.74:1 on surface (large text / marks only). Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Encouragement banner text on success-soft. 3.71:1 — FAILS 4.5:1 for its 13px size; kept from source. Darken to #2f7a5c (4.72:1) if you need AA. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Encouragement banner fill. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Streak flame and count. Measured #f69716 on the home streak pill. 2.24:1 — icon/large only.

tokens.name: streak-soft
tokens.usage: Flame highlight / inner glow. Lossy.

tokens.name: day-over
tokens.usage: Week-strip ring for a day that went over the calorie goal. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: day-met
tokens.usage: Week-strip ring for a day within goal. 1.85:1 — decorative; the selected state also changes the tile fill. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Default initials avatar fill (gradient to avatar-2). White initials on it are 2.46:1 — FAILS; use ink initials or a darker fill for AA. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the initials avatar gradient. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: camera-tile
tokens.usage: Unselected camera mode tiles (Barcode, Food Label) on the live camera view. Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Circular buttons floating over photos (back, share, more, close, flash). Approximated from #484844 over imagery; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(20px). Lossy (v1 marketing screenshots).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (added for web). 17:1 on surface.

groups.name: Display & numerals
groups.note: Semibold (600) throughout — the source never goes heavier. Tight leading (~1.1). Widths match Hanken Grotesk within 1.5%.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Hero numbers: calories left on Home, setup percentage ('18%'). Measured cap 30.7–32pt.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles, left-aligned in onboarding (centred on statement screens). Measured cap 23.7pt, line pitch 38.2pt.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: Picked values above rulers/sliders ('1.0 kg', '77.0 kg').

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Metric values in dashboard cards. Lossy (not in Figma set).

styles.name: stat-md
styles.usage: Macro amounts on macro cards; rating '4.8'.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 17px is the workhorse. Sentence case. Weight separates levels: 600 headings/buttons, 500 labels, 400 running text.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section and card titles ('Daily recommendation', 'You should gain:').

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Column headers, emphasised values, nav titles.

styles.name: btn-label
styles.usage: All button labels (measured width matches 600 exactly).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This will be used to calibrate your custom plan.
styles.usage: Subtitles under titles, review text, slider labels. Line pitch measured 19.2pt.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Secondary values in rows and cards (amounts, '/goal' suffixes). Lossy size from v1.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels under stats on Home cards, tab labels.

spacing.note: 4px base. Onboarding content sits 24pt from the edges; the bottom CTA 16pt; Home content 30pt (measured 29–30). Option cards stack 12pt apart.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between option cards, list rows and home cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Bottom CTA side inset; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Title → subtitle gap; inner padding of large cards (19–20 measured).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Onboarding screen gutter; gap between paired Yes/No buttons.

tokens.name: space-gutter-home
tokens.usage: Home screen gutter (cards, week strip, FAB right edge). Measured 29–30.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between the header row and the title block.

radius.note: Controls are pills; option cards and inputs 15; inner cards 12; home cards 20. Measured by circle-fitting 3x corners (±0.5pt).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Wheel-picker selection pill, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner plan cards, tooltip, thumbnails (measured 11–12).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Option cards, list rows, inputs, review card, Recommended pill (measured 14.4–15.6).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Home cards (calorie, macro), Daily recommendation container (measured 19.6–20.1).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners. Lossy.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, switch, slider, progress bars, back button, FAB, avatars.

shadow.note: Onboarding is flat (no shadows on option cards). Home cards float on soft, wide shadows; the CTA area is lifted by a white-to-grey fade.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Home cards and inner plan cards at rest (estimated from a ~10pt soft halo).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: FAB, tab bar, slider thumb, floating cards.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Upward fade above the pinned bottom CTA area (measured #fafafa→#f0f0f0 over ~70pt).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (added for web).

size.note: Measured in pt at 3x (= px on the web).

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Primary CTAs: Continue, Get Started, Yes/No, Sign in (measured 58.0).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Compact paired actions inside sheets. Lossy.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline Submit inside an input, segmented control.

tokens.name: option-row
tokens.usage: Single-line option card / list row (measured 69–70).

tokens.name: option-row-2
tokens.usage: Option card with a subtitle line.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text input (Referral Code).

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round back button (measured 38.7–40).

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: Floating add button (measured 64).

tokens.name: step-bar
tokens.usage: Onboarding step progress bar thickness.

tokens.name: slider-bar
tokens.usage: Slider track thickness; thumb 27.

tokens.name: ring-stroke
tokens.usage: Home calorie ring stroke; macro rings use 8.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch width (height 31).
